rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual noun for a video, film, or clip.

example.english: I just finished watching that video.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 tai2 jyun4 go2 pin2

rows.note: Use this written or formal term for a recorded film or video.

example.english: This video will be released next month.
example.traditional: 呢部影片將於下月上映。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 jing2 pin2 zoeng1 jyu1 haa6 jyut6 soeng6 jing2

rows.note: Use this technical term for video or visual media, especially when contrasted with audio.

example.english: This system supports video and audio transmission.
example.traditional: 呢個系統支援視像同音訊傳送。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 tung2 zi1 wun4 si6 zoeng6 tung4 jam1 seon3 cyun4 sung3
